title: CULTURAL FIDELITY IN LARGE-LANGUAGE MODELS: AN EVALUATION OF ONLINE LANGUAGE RESOURCES AS A DRIVER OF MODEL PERFORMANCE IN VALUE REPRESENTATION

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to answer World Values Survey questions from the perspective of a citizen from 21 different countries in their native languages, and calculating the error rate by comparing the generated numerical responses to the actual average human survey responses for those countries.

Correlating the societal representation error rates with the volume of available digital resources (log number of websites) for each language to measure the performance disparity between high-resource and low-resource languages.
